ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a triangle WAH, with vertex W at the lower left, H above, and A at the lower right; point P is located on side HA, and segment WP goes from vertex W to point P on side HA. The problem states that WP is an angle bisector, so WP bisects ∠HWA, therefore ∠HWP is half of the entire ∠HWA. It is known that m∠HWP = x + 12 and m∠HWA = 4x - 16, so 4x - 16 = 2(x + 12). Solving gives 4x - 16 = 2x + 24, 2x = 40, x = 20. AP and PH, as well as the median condition, do not need to be used to find x.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle WAH with point P on side HA and segment WP drawn from vertex W to side HA. From the text, WP is an angle bisector, so it splits angle HWA into two equal angles: angle HWP equals angle PWA. The text gives m∠HWP = x + 12 and m∠HWA = 4x - 16. Therefore set the whole angle equal to twice the half-angle: 4x - 16 = 2(x + 12). Solve to get x = 20. The median information and the AP, PH expressions can be noted as extra information not needed for x in this route.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle WAH, with P lying on side HA, so angle PAW is the same angle as HAW at vertex A. From the text, WP is both a median and an angle bisector. Since WP is a median to side HA, P is the midpoint, so HP = PA. Combining this with the angle-bisector theorem for angle HWA gives WH/WA = HP/PA = 1, hence WH = WA. Therefore triangle WAH is isosceles with base HA, so the base angles at H and A are equal. Since m∠PAW = 3x - 2 represents the A-angle, the H-angle is also 3x - 2. Use the triangle angle sum: (4x - 16) + (3x - 2) + (3x - 2) = 180. Solving gives x = 20.

图像描述：图中是三角形 WAH，W 在左下方，H 在上方，A 在右侧；点 P 位于边 HA 上，线段 WP 从顶点 W 连到边 HA 上的点 P。图中还出现点 Q 和一条内部线段，但本题计算 x 按给出的 WP 为中线和角平分线条件进行。

推理：因为 WP 是三角形 WAH 中从 W 到边 HA 的中线，所以 P 是 HA 的中点，因此 HP = PA。又因为 WP 是 ∠HWA 的角平分线，根据角平分线定理，WH/WA = HP/PA。由于 HP = PA，所以 HP/PA = 1，从而 WH/WA = 1，即 WH = WA。因此三角形 WAH 是等腰三角形，底边为 HA，底角 ∠WHA 和 ∠HAW 相等。由于 P 在 HA 上，所以 ∠PAW 与 ∠HAW 是同一个 A 处的角，m∠PAW = 3x - 2，因此 H 处的底角也等于 3x - 2。顶角 m∠HWA = 4x - 16。由三角形内角和：
(4x - 16) + (3x - 2) + (3x - 2) = 180。
合并得 10x - 20 = 180，所以 10x = 200，x = 20。
